definitions.gloss: personnel change; staff transfer; organizational reshuffle
definitions.explanation: Changes in personnel assignments within an organization, including transfers, promotions, demotions, and departmental reassignments. A routine practice in Japanese companies, typically occurring in April.

examples.japanese: {四月|しがつ}に{人事|じんじ}{異動|いどう}がある。
examples.english: There will be personnel changes in April.

examples.japanese: {人事|じんじ}{異動|いどう}で{営業部|えいぎょうぶ}に{配属|はいぞく}された。
examples.english: I was assigned to the sales department in the personnel reshuffle.

examples.japanese: {大規模|だいきぼ}な{人事|じんじ}{異動|いどう}が{発表|はっぴょう}され、{社内|しゃない}は{騒然|そうぜん}としている。
examples.english: A large-scale personnel reshuffle was announced, and the office is in an uproar.

notes:
USAGE:
In Japanese companies, {人事|じんじ}{異動|いどう} typically happens at the start of the fiscal year (April) or mid-year (October). It is a normal part of corporate life and can include transfers to different departments, branch offices, or even subsidiaries.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人事|じんじ}{異動|いどう}が{発表|はっぴょう}される (personnel changes are announced)
- {人事|じんじ}{異動|いどう}の{内示|ないじ} (unofficial notification of transfer)
- {定期|ていき}{人事|じんじ}{異動|いどう} (regular personnel reshuffle)
- {人事|じんじ}{異動|いどう}の{季節|きせつ} (personnel transfer season)
